name: garaANT
source: I’m about to take the exam. Nothing too complicated—just a neat hairstyle, some nice makeup, and walk in with confidence. But … it’s not my exam at all! And I’m a guy. Something tells me things won’t go exactly as planned. What specific twist or complication might happen? Will there be an opportunity for me to turn this situation into something advantageous? I wish I knew…
